scientific_integrity: One theorem covers the algebraic exact distribution and its conditional Gaussian asymptotics, with proof distinct from finite computational checks.
scientific_limitations: Binary words over the fixed ambient alphabet {0,1} only.
Each word has equal counts of both letters; no nonzero-imbalance generalization is established.
The executable verifier checks finitely many coefficients and words; the all-length and limit laws require the written proofs.
An unindexed equivalent formula may remain undiscovered.
title: Balanced binary words: exact subsequence-universality spectrum and a Gaussian law
